poll.question: At the van door, Dan blocks Hui's path. She can't leave those birds to die outside. Who gives?

options.label: Hui steps back
options.desc: Survival means holding the line, together.

options.label: Dan moves aside
options.desc: Caging her will cost him far more than the birds ever will.

options.label: Tend them on the ramp
options.desc: She acts; the van stays sealed. A way through neither has named yet.

in_play.label: Make a deal
in_play.desc: Both their instincts are right. Help the birds without breaking the seal.
